dogecoin.text: The SEC received its first filings for Trump, Dogecoin (DOGE) and Bonk (BONK) ETFs. The approval of memecoin-based ETFs is more likely under new SEC acting Chair Mark Uyeda.

Aptos is Bitwise's latest effort to expand from the spot Bitcoin, Ether, XRP, and Dogecoin it has on offer. Bitwise launched an Aptos Staking ETP on Switzerland’s SIX Swiss Exchange in November that offers a 4.7% return on staking yield. https://t.co/mODkbJSsKw
